title: Illinois Employee Sick Leave Act family use
facts: Illinois's Employee Sick Leave Act does not itself require employers to create paid or unpaid sick leave.
If an employer provides personal sick leave, employees must generally be allowed to use at least half of those sick-leave benefits to care for covered family members.
Covered family members include a child, stepchild, spouse, domestic partner, sibling, parent, parent-in-law, grandchild, grandparent, and stepparent.
